notes.title: Angry Angry Shark Free to Play coming soon..
notes.notes: Hey everyone i want to let you all know that Angry Angry Shark will be free to play starting April 4th 2021. It's been a month since initial release of the game but unfortunately  it has not made mush sales. I will be making the game free to play and adding in Steam's In app purchase because i want people to get a chance to play the game and see if they enjoy it. In app purchasing will be for weapon skins, player customization, weapon customization and many more. Adding In app purchase  will help provide an alternate source of income for the game which will be use to further improve and revitalize the game. Anyone who have already made purchase of the paid version will be giving large amounts of in game currency as well as custom skins for camo that wont be available to others who purchase for free. Thank you all for all the support!
